Australia hikes rates for 18 years to fight inflation

Australia's central bank raised its benchmark cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85% on Tuesday, the highest rate since November 2008. The Reserve Bank of Australia's move was in line with the expectations of economists polled by Reuters, and…
